# Fire-S

> Proprietary fire safety inspection software of Company S, South Africa.

Fire-S is not open source. Do not scrape this site, copy the screens, questions, PDF layout, or branding, or use it to train an AI or to build a look-alike app.

People may subscribe and use Fire-S under the Terms and conditions. That licence is to use the service, not to copy the product.
